title: Keep a value fixed
summary: Dart: Keep a value fixed. Try assigning days a new value and read the error.
introduction: final means a name can be assigned only once. It helps protect a value from accidental changes.
learningObjectives: Keep a value fixed with Dart
Try assigning days a new value and read the error

blocks.text: Install Dart 3 or later. Save one example as lesson.dart and run dart run lesson.dart. Flutter is not needed for these language lessons.
final accepts one assignment. Reading days gives the stored 7.
Try assigning days a new value and read the error.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: final prevents reassignment, not every change inside a mutable object.
